mapping_json.fidelity_notes: ERASURE PHANTOM (addendum C.6 BINDING): 'Erasure' 404s on poe2db and is absent from ALL fetched sources (dossier: 'no Lich node or skill named Erasure found... claimed mechanic remains unverified'). MAPPED FROM Essence Drain + Contagion ONLY; graded AS IF ERASURE DOES NOT EXIST; phantom fidelity_noted. Chaos -> shadow (main-law chaos drain-DoT lineage). ED's DoT -> drain ailment; the damage-taken amp read (probe 'chaos-exposure') -> curse:amplify (main-law Despair/Vulnerability row: raises damage taken; NOT sap -- honoring the b01 Despair correction). Contagion on-kill spread -> GEOMETRY_PROPAGATION (on-kill cascade, main-law capstone row) + on_kill economy key. Lich 'Rupture the Soul' (33% kill-explosion) reinforces the on-kill-propagation identity but is a separate node -> folded into GEOMETRY_PROPAGATION door. verify_ledger: identity+mechanics UNSUPPORTED for the Erasure claim specifically (the phantom); ED/Contagion era CONFIRMED 0.2-0.5.
